title: Stopping Between Chord Changes? Here's How To Fix It!
summary: In this JustinGuitar lesson, the core message is to avoid stopping the rhythm when changing chords, a habit that makes mistakes obvious to listeners. The instructor explains that “forcing the changes” to happen on the beat—while keeping the strumming continuous—preserves the groove and makes errors less noticeable. He demonstrates how rhythm can vanish when you stop, and advocates practicing with a metronome, drum grooves, or backing tracks to build solid timing. A structured practice approach is offered, including a one-minute-changes drill to push speed, the use of play-along songs (via the beginner song course app) for real-world feel, and tools like the JustinGuitar Time Trainer. The takeaway is that rhythm drives music, beat-one alignment is essential, and consistent tempo will improve chord-change speed over time.
